Support |cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Cooldown]]45 |initial_cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Initial Cooldown]]30 |use_limit = 3 |audio-1 = [[File:NapalmStrikeConsumableAudio.ogg]] |usable_in = PVE }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Airstrike that leaves an AOE field around the designated spot, applying burn to enemies that pass through.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Napalm Strike''' is one of the four rare [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''Napalm Strike''' has a 2.78% (5.41% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]], a 6.15% (9.41% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]] and a 22.03% (21.67% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[High Grade Crate]]. Only up to three '''Napalm Strikes''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 45 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 30 seconds. ==Usage== When using the '''Napalm Strike''', your avatar's right hand will hold a radio, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the '''Napalm Strike''' will fire napalm bombs at. These bombs will create a wall of fire with a big radius. This wall of fire lasts for 15 seconds, dealing 8 damage every 0.1 seconds (80 DPS) to any enemy that passes through it, as long as it is not [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] or [[Burn Immunity|Burn Immune]]. Enemies will be set on fire for 10 seconds, receiving 4 damage every 0.75 seconds (5.33 DPS), dealing 80 damage in total. It will also drop their defense by 15% every tick. It can only drop up to 50% of the enemy's defense. As it drops it through fire, any other fire based defense dropping, such as the [[Molotov]] or [[Pyromancer]], will not stack with it. ==Appearance== The '''Napalm Strike''' is a Grumman F-14D Tomcat that fires missiles. The inventory and hotbar icon shows fire in the top right corner to indicate that it is the '''Napalm Strike''' consumable. ==Strategy== *The rapid-fire damage of the '''Napalm Strike''' is effective against groups of slow enemies, capable of dealing a large amount of damage before the enemy leaves the fire. **If you want the wall of fire to cover as much of the path as possible, face the direction of the straight path so that the bombs will drop around the area. **It can be useful for dropping the defense against the groups of enemies, such as the [[Fallen Guardian]] if defense dropping towers are not placed down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Props}} ConsumablePropTomcat.png|Tomcat }} ==Update History== *'''10 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0]] **'''Napalm Strike''' added. **{{Bug}} Wall of fire deals no damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. **{{Bug}} Wall of fire can be collided with. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.31.0]] **{{Bug}} Damage no longer generates cash in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and special maps. *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **Burn no longer prevents enemies from being frozen. {{ConsumableNavBox}}
